title: Mento Issue
role: Game Designer, Programmer, Artist & Sound Designer
summary: A Global Game Jam 2025 game on the theme "Bubble", built around the reaction between Mentos and soda — winner of the Non-Traditional Award at GGJ Pittsburgh.

blocks.text: Yen-Chun Huang, Jack Peng, Alex Hall, and I attended the Global Game Jam Pittsburgh. The theme of the jam was "bubbles," which inspired us to create a game based on the reaction between Mentos and soda. Our concept was well received by the audience, earning us the Non-Traditional Award at the event.

Players control half a pack of Mentiez (a Mentos-like candy) with the ability to throw mints. The goal is to reunite with the other half of the pack — but the only way to navigate the map is by using Mentos to trigger special bubble effects from sodas.
The first version of the game is available on both [itch.io](https://yenchun.itch.io/mento-issue) and the GGJ website. Feel free to check it out and enjoy a piece of Mentiez!
